notes.title: 🎉 New Update Available! 🎉
notes.content:
Greetings, brave knights and adventurers! We're excited to roll out a major update for The Chronicles of Lancelot! Here’s what’s new:

🔥 Engine Upgrade:

We’ve upgraded the game engine to Unity 6, bringing better performance, smoother gameplay, and enhanced visuals!

Optimized 3d models and reduced memory usage for a more seamless experience.

💥 New Reward: Threesome After Pestilence Boss Battle:

Triumph over Pestilence and enjoy a steamy new reward. Unlock this exclusive scene after the fight to spice up your adventure! 💖🔥

⚔️ Battle and Skill Balancing:

Adjusted skill and damage scaling for more balanced combat.

Reworked some abilities for more strategic gameplay.

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Miscellaneous Updates:

Fixed various bugs affecting quest progression and dialogue.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Stay tuned for more updates and exciting content.

💙 Team Lancelot

notes.title: 🌈 Fabulous Update Alert! 🌈
notes.content:
Hey, gaymer adventurers! It’s time to get your glam on because we’ve sprinkled some extra magic (and just a little sass) into your favorite world! Check out the new goodies below:

✨ New Defend Effect: Defending now comes with a bit more sparkle! Shield yourself like a true diva and watch those enemies gasp at your fabulousness.

🔥 New Sexy Monster in Town! 🔥 Near the end of the game, you might bump into a very attractive (but seriously strong) monster. Don’t let those looks fool you—this one's ready to throw down!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012384/ad60486891a15a957738141f25b3bff583769fa4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012384/e868af422544685e0651606756978130d6398f47.jpg[/img]

💀 Mass Death Drama: When you wipe out all enemies with one epic skill, they’ll now drop like flies all at once. No more waiting for each to take their dramatic solo exit. They all know it’s your stage, darling.

🏃 Arthur’s Fainting Fix: Oops! We noticed Arthur was running off after his HP hit zero. We’ve convinced him to stay down this time, no more sprinting with no pulse!

🧭 Escape with Style: Tired of fleeing in the wrong direction? Fear not! Escaping now takes you exactly where you want to go—no more embarrassing wrong turns.

⚔️ Battle Balance Tweaks: We’ve polished and shined up the battle mechanics so you can be even more fabulous while whooping some serious butt!

So put on your adventure boots and get ready to slay, queens (and kings)! 💅👑

notes.title: Minor update released to fix a bug in the graveyard.
notes.content:
Hello, Our Gayeti - Unikorn gaymer!

We have released a minor update to fix a bug in the graveyard. Previously, if you lost a battle, there was a chance you would be reloaded directly back into the battle scene and unable to return to the main scene. This issue was caused by enabling autosave during the battle scene, so when you lost, the game automatically reloaded to the battle scene, preventing a return to the main scene.

To fix this bug, you can reinstall the game (your save files will not be affected). We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. We are continually taking feedback and improving the game, so if you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please reach out to us on our Discord channel or via email.

Thank you for your understanding and support.


And hey, if you find yourself thoroughly enjoying the game, we would be grateful if you could tell three friends who share your gaming interests. ´• ل •`

Your support helps us grow and enhances the gaming experience. (•ө•)♡

Warm regards,
Gayeti-Unikorn 🌈🦄

P.S: For any issues or questions, connect with us on Discord: https://discord.gg/VanaDXNdZE, email (info@gayeti.com). We're here to ensure your experience is seamless.
